record: RQ1 static-vs-transient comparison in reliability-index terms

metric.interval_method: monotone image of the exact Clopper-Pearson interval
metric.delta_beta_interval_method: paired percentile bootstrap over the shared realization set

resolution_criteria.R1_estimand: the transient failure count at the level
resolution_criteria.R1_reason: both estimators are functions of the same two counts on the same rows, so a count floor governs both; this is the shared sample, not a map between metrics
resolution_criteria.R2_estimand: the multiplicative width of the 95 per cent interval on B
resolution_criteria.R2_reason: dbeta depends on both branch probabilities, not on their ratio, so a width condition on B carries no verdict to it
resolution_criteria.R2_beta_estimand: the additive width of the directly evaluated 95 per cent paired-bootstrap interval on dbeta
resolution_criteria.R2_beta_derivation: ADR-0040 s1.1 set R2 = 2.0 so the interval occupies log10(2) = 0.301 of the decade the ratio claim is quoted to; the same fraction of the one index unit the four design-level dbeta values span (0.90 to 1.87) gives 0.30
